newsitem.title: CANADA: Revenue Properties unit in refinancing.
newsitem.headline: Revenue Properties unit in refinancing.

text.p: Revenue Properties Co Ltd on Friday said its Pan Pacific Development unit completed the US$63.7 million refinancing of five U.S. shopping centers.
The Toronto-based real estate company said the new financing consists of a US$58.7 million 10-year fixed rate loan bearing interest at 8.2 percent and a US$5 million five-year variable rate loan.
The proceeds were used to repay existing variable rate project debt scheduled to mature on December 31, 1996, provide working capital, and pay the costs of the refinancing, the company said.

Revenue Properties said the loans were placed with CIBC Wood Gundy's real estate securitization unit based in New York. The five shopping centers covered in the transaction are located in Nevada, Washington, Kentucky, New Mexico and California.

Fixed rate financing now accounts for more than 85 percent of Revenue Properties' total indebtedness, reducing exposure to interest rate swings, the company said. It said management believes that current interest rates are near cyclical lows and views the refinancing as opportune.
